1. GitHub Settings → Notifications: Enable email notifications for Watching and Participating, @mentions and custom.
2. Customize email updates: Enable Comments on Issues and Pull Requests and Includes your own updates.
3. Repository → Watch → Custom: Enable Issues and click Apply.
4. Create a permanent Issue: Create one Issue to receive all form-submission comments and keep it open.
5. Workflow permissions: Give the GitHub Action permission to write to Issues.
6. Decrypt submission: Have the Action decrypt the incoming form submission into JSON.
7. Post comment: Have github-actions[bot] post the decrypted JSON as a comment on the permanent Issue.
8. Receive email: GitHub emails every new comment to Gmail with the actual JSON content in the email body.
